scope.description: Reconstruct the unpushed LongLineage feature work on current origin/main without forbidden history, repair current-head CI/governance/hygiene regressions, comprehensively validate the truthful non-production scope, and publish a private draft PR without promoting blocked scientific phases.

assumptions: The locked production input contract remains raw BAM plus exact latest HP/PS sidecar; no second persisted tagged BAM is required.
Complete means complete verification of this draft publication scope, not false promotion of P3-P8 or the production release attestation.
The source feature branch remains an immutable local recovery reference until the sanitized branch is independently verified.
The publishable branch follows the repository fix/* naming contract and Python cache files remain ignored.

step_verify.step: Reconstruct the feature tree from current origin/main and remove every forbidden current-tree and reachable-history payload.
step_verify.verify: Repository hygiene and an independent reachable-history scan both exit 0 with zero violations.

step_verify.step: Repair the current-head governance and negative-test regressions without changing scientific decisions.
step_verify.verify: Compiled governance check-all and all 46 or later registered CTests exit 0 from a clean checkout.

step_verify.step: Run the full applicable compiler, sanitizer, schema, determinism, presentation and foundation verification matrix.
step_verify.verify: Every applicable command has exit 0, immutable evidence, and blocked release-only gates remain explicitly blocked.

step_verify.step: Commit the reviewed scope, push the sanitized branch and open a private draft pull request.
step_verify.verify: Remote head SHA equals local HEAD and the draft PR exposes successful current-branch Actions checks.

deviations: The first hosted runs for commit b9797605cdc859e571c1961c1b4343c40d7c7183 exposed an undeclared Boost header dependency: all six compiler/sanitizer matrix builds failed before tests, while history hygiene and browser QA passed. The dependency is now declared in CMake, hosted CI, the production-image builder and the lock contract; failed runs are not completion evidence.

Subsequent hosted runs exposed a Clang-only unused-constant warning, sanitizer-visible Jansson and BGZF lifetime leaks, and missing Git provenance/tooling in the deliberately .git-free container context. Each issue was repaired without changing scientific decisions; the failed hosted runs remain negative evidence only.

Independent review rejected the initial shape-only source commit check because a fabricated 40-hex value or dirty checkout could be mislabeled. The repaired contract verifies clean HEAD when Git metadata exists, makes .git-free provenance an explicit trusted-CI assertion, and consumes the commit argument after stable dependency layers.
